newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends lower on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends lower on dollar demand.

text.p: Higher call money rates and increased demand for dollars from importers pushed the taka down to 42.8430/8490 at the close against the dollar in interbank trading, delaers said.

Dealers said the taka opened generally steady at 42.8400/8480 to the dollar against the previous close at at 42.8420/8480 but lost ground later after demand from importers picked up ahead of the Moslem Friday weekend. "There was a crisis for dollars and some banks had to buy from the central bank," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates closed higher at 6.25 percent to 6.75 against the previous 5.5-6.0 percent.
